description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) scores for different Large Language Models (LLMs) under varying conditions. The horizontal axis represents the LLM, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B”, “LLaMA-2-13B”, and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the percentage score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each LLM category, grouped side-by-side; the first set, in light blue, represents “+ SFT on D₀”, the second, in orange, represents “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and the third, in light red with diagonal stripes, represents “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. For LLaMA-2-7B, the light blue bar reaches approximately 65, the orange bar reaches approximately 72, and the light red bar reaches approximately 78. For LLaMA-2-13B, the light blue bar reaches approximately 68, the orange bar reaches approximately 75, and the light red bar reaches approximately 80. For LLaMA-2-70B, the light blue bar reaches approximately 70, the orange bar reaches approximately 77, and the light red bar reaches approximately 80. The bars are sorted alphabetically by LLM name, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend in the lower right corner identifies the color and pattern associated with each condition.
